title: Staff Build & Release Engineer - DevOps
description: Job Description Summary As a Staff Build & Release Engineer – DevOps, you will be responsible for providing build and release strategy and hands on implementation for highly complex as well as parallel and concurrent releases for a Software Product. You will manage Continuous Code Integration, Deployments and Tests within Software Development Life Cycle, working independently and is seen as a Technical Leader. The role demonstrates deep understanding of concurrent software development, its effect on build management and releasing the builds across versions and environments. Job Description Responsibilities Owning strategy, designing and implementation for builds, continuous integration, delivery, test and release processes for large and complex releases of a product and at times expands the scope across multiple concurrent releases. Managing and improving release process, focusing on scale and efficiency and deploying the right builds across environments. Managing key deliverables and mentors junior team members. Contributing in driving initiatives such as defining standards and processes to ensure quality. Working cross functionally with other business departments to align activities and deliverables. Developing and enhancing the test infrastructure and continuous integration framework used across teams. Determining best practices and principals and promotes them across the team. Demonstrating expert knowledge in developing and executing automated builds and scripts. Learning new build and releasing techniques and methodologies and trains the team in the same. Working with developers and stakeholders to deliver quality software through the build and deployment system. Partnering with and provides direction to fellow team members to diagnose bugs and formulate solutions. Evangelisting and adopting and use industry best practices to improve Build, Release and Continuous integration and delivery processes. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong experience in software development with a strong focus on DevOps principles and practices. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Extensive experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, CircleCI). Strong understanding and experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Solid understanding of networking concepts, operating systems (Linux/Windows), and database systems. Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef). Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack). Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. #LI-MT1 #LI-Hybrid Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Technical Project Manager – Product Lifecycle (f/m/d)
hiring_org: MS0017 GE Healthcare Austria GmbH & Co OG
description: Job Description Summary To strengthen our ultrasound probe engineering team in Zipf (Austria), we are looking for a Technical Project Manager – Product Lifecycle (f/m/d). In this role, you will lead strategic installed base and cost-out initiatives across the ultrasound probes portfolio, driving product reliability, change management, compliance, cost optimization, and continuous improvement throughout the product lifecycle. At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs - the human touch. Job Description Key Responsibilities: Lead and drive cross-functional installed base and cost-out initiatives across the ultrasound probes organization. Lead root cause investigations for field and manufacturing issues, ensuring effective corrective and preventive actions that improve product reliability and customer satisfaction. Evaluate and coordinate design changes, ensuring clear cross-functional alignment and timely execution. Assess the impact of product changes on product performance, patient safety, quality, reliability, cost, regulatory compliance, and the installed base. Provide technical recommendations and support risk-based decision-making for product lifecycle and installed base topics. Support compliance activities, external audits and quality initiatives by ensuring complete, audit-ready documentation and robust engineering practices. Drive standardization, operational excellence, and best-practice sharing across global engineering sites and cross-functional organizations. Collaborate closely within a global organization, including close alignment with cross-functional teams across multiple sites. Required Qualifications: University degree in engineering, technology or a related discipline Advanced experience in Engineering, Technology, Product Lifecycle Management, or Program Management. Proven organizational and project management skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Ability to assess technical, quality, regulatory, and business impacts to support effective decision-making. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and lead initiatives in a fast-paced environment. High level of ownership, accountability, and execution focus. Excellent interpersonal, influencing, and communication skills with the ability to build alignment across global and cross-functional teams. Fluent German and English, both written and spoken. Desired Qualifications Several years of experience in engineering, product lifecycle management, installed base support, technical program leadership, or a related field. Familiarity with ultrasound probes or similar electromechanical systems in a regulated industry Understanding of design controls and post-market surveillance Background in reliability engineering or field performance analysis What we offer: We offer a role specific compensation and a competitive salary and fringe benefit package reflecting your profile and experience. In Austria we are required to state the minimum pay. For this position, the annual compensation package starts at € 65.000. We will be pleased to discuss the appropriate effective salary based on your qualifications and experience. An exciting and diverse range of responsibilities in a growth-oriented company An interdisciplinary team and an international work environment Flextime and flexible working hours Free electric charging stations and ample parking facilities on the company premises An additional day off for your birthday Convenient public transportation access with a complimentary company shuttle to the Redl-Zipf train station, located 2 km away If you are interested in learning more we are looking forward to your online-application! Don't meet all the requirements? We are aware that there is almost never a perfect profile. You can learn (almost) anything as long as you are interested and enjoy new topics and challenges. In short: we look forward to receiving your application, even if you do not yet meet the requirements 100%! About us GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally. We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health - digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world. description:

Job Description About the team: Every CT image a radiologist interprets passes through our software. We transform raw detector measurements into clinically meaningful images that help physicians diagnose strokes, detect tumors, identify fractures, and guide critical patient care decisions. This work requires balancing image quality, computational performance, radiation dose, and the realities of clinical workflows. Our team operates at the intersection of software engineering, applied mathematics, high-performance computing, and medical device development. Build scalable, high-performance software components that leverage modern computing architectures, including multicore CPUs, GPUs, and heterogeneous compute environments. Develop platform capabilities, APIs, tooling, and automation that improve developer productivity, software quality, testability, and deployment efficiency. Partner closely with algorithm developers, system engineers, and product teams to understand requirements and deliver robust platform solutions that accelerate innovation. Strong intellectual curiosity and a desire to understand systems deeply, not just use them. Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies, tools, and domains quickly and independently. Self-motivated and energized by solving difficult, ambiguous problems with limited direction. Takes ownership of problems, drives solutions to completion, and continuously seeks better approaches. Resourceful in overcoming obstacles and finding practical solutions when the path forward is unclear. Comfortable contributing across all phases of software development, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, debugging, performance optimization, and support. Strong systems-thinking skills with the ability to understand complex interactions across software and hardware components. Collaborative team player who elevates those around them through knowledge sharing, constructive discussion, and technical leadership. Strong understanding of Linux systems programming, concurrency, multithreading, memory management, and performance optimization. Experience with distributed systems, microservices architectures, containers, orchestration technologies, and cloud-native development practices. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, build systems, automated testing frameworks, developer tooling, and software quality processes. Experience developing software that leverages GPUs or heterogeneous compute environments, including integration with CUDA, OpenCL, or other accelerator technologies. Familiarity with observability and operational tooling, including logging, monitoring, profiling, debugging, and performance analysis. Experience designing APIs and software architectures that support extensibility, maintainability, and long-term product evolution. Medical imaging, scientific computing, high-performance computing, or other computationally intensive software domains. description:
Job Description Summary As an AI Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and deploying agentic AI systems that reason, plan, act, and learn in complex real world environments. You will develop end to end intelligent agents that orchestrate large language models (LLMs), tools, data sources, and workflows to deliver reliable, production grade automation for clinical and operational use cases. You will work at the intersection of AI research, software engineering, and product delivery—bridging AI capabilities with scalable systems that can operate autonomously, collaborate with humans, and adapt over time within regulated healthcare settings. GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. Job Description Your responsibilities include the following: Designing and developing agentic AI architectures that combine LLMs with planning, tool use, memory, and feedback loops to automate and augment clinical and operational workflows. Building multi‑step reasoning and decision‑making agents that can decompose tasks, select tools, invoke external systems (e.g. databases, APIs, services), and adapt based on outcomes. Orchestrating AI agents across data modalities including medical images, electronic medical records, waveforms, and clinical reports. Defining evaluation strategies for agent behavior, including task success, robustness, safety, and alignment—beyond traditional model accuracy metrics. Developing production‑ready systems for agent deployment, monitoring, observability, and lifecycle management , including guardrails, auditing, and human‑in‑the‑loop controls. Building scalable, service‑oriented platforms and reusable components that enable multiple teams to compose, customize, and govern AI agents across products. Prototyping and iterating quickly to validate agent behavior in realistic workflows, then hardening solutions for regulated, high‑reliability environments. Staying current with advances in agentic AI, LLM tooling, orchestration frameworks, and applied AI system design. Basic Qualifications Graduate degree in Computer Science or a related field, with two or more years of industry experience. Strong experience in software engineering for AI systems, including designing distributed, stateful, or event‑driven services. Hands‑on experience with LLMs and agent frameworks , such as tool calling, function execution, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), memory, and planning patterns. Proficiency in one or more general‑purpose programming languages (e.g. Python, Java, C/C++). Experience working with large‑scale data and production platforms (e.g. Spark, Hadoop, cloud‑native services). Practical experience deploying and operating AI systems in production, including monitoring, logging, and failure handling. Preferred Qualifications Experience building autonomous or semi‑autonomous agents in real‑world, noisy, or high‑stakes environments. Familiarity with AI safety, guardrails, interpretability, and human‑in‑the‑loop system design. Experience handling real‑world medical or patient data and working within regulated environments. title: Engineering Manager RadioPharmacy
description: Job Description Summary We are looking for our next Engineering Leader for the Global RadioPharma business segment, part of the Molecular Imaging and Computed Tomography (MICT) Engineering team at GE HealthCare. This role leads an engineering team responsible for RadioPharmaceutical Isotope production systems and processing solutions. These systems and solutions play an increasingly important role in Oncology, Neurology, and Cardiology care pathways, enabling early and precise diagnosis for personalized treatment and therapy guidance. Our products impact the care of millions of patients daily and support cutting-edge medical research. GE HealthCare has been a leader in medical imaging history and continues to define the future of this essential work. This role oversees all engineering efforts across Field, Factory, and Futures activities for the RadioPharma business segment. Specifically, the leader guides the team responsible for delivering successful Advanced Technology Development (ATD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs, meeting key deliverables, driving end-to-end execution, achieving product quality targets, and ensuring business continuity through Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Service. This leader will work with product management teams, manufacturing, and sourcing to support customers and ensure customer operations uptime, manufacturing continuity, safety, quality, and cost. This position requires guiding the engineering team in solving technical problems in the field or factory, and shaping customer-needs-based and outcomes-driven global technology and innovation roadmaps for future products and solutions. The role demands acting on all matters related to the RadioPharma engineering department and program plans, within the boundaries defined for each program and the overall engineering budget. Participation in the GEHC business process, including World Wide Technology Planning (WWTP), World Wide Product Planning (WWPP), Long Term Strategy (LTS), and Annual Talent Review sessions, is essential. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities: Own the complete end-to-end engineering of RadioPharmaceutical Isotope production systems and processing solutions – roadmap, conceptualization, design, implementation, and install base management. Manage team stakeholders and priorities; work closely with the RadioPharma Business Segment leader, Product Management, Marketing, Service, and Program Management Office to prioritize engineering activities and define system roadmaps. Clearly communicate complex technical information and progress in an organized, simple, and easy-to-understand manner to both leadership and team members. Provide operational management for the engineering team; manage budgets, milestones, and KPIs for ongoing support and projects. Drive ATD projects for new ideas and innovations. Ensure that engineering teams consider design for manufacturability, install, and service early in the product design cycle. Collaborate with advanced manufacturing engineering and sourcing teams, ensuring their inputs are considered in design. Handle the deliverables of a team of 40 to 50 engineers with diverse skills, ensuring that programs are delivered on time with safety and quality requirements through Lean and Design for Six Sigma practices. Foster technical leadership and engineering excellence in the core technologies required for these systems and corresponding subsystems. Manage career development and performance processes. Promote the growth of technical experts in these core technologies and ensure the depth and breadth of the team for supporting new designs and installed base quality. Coach and mentor the engineering team with end-to-end ownership and accountability. Drive rigor in design controls, design transfer, verification, validation, and acceptance activities to ensure that product, equipment, tools, processes, software, training, and documentation meet requirements. Ensure product compliance with Local and Global regulatory guidelines, rules, and standards; GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position. Be a key member of the Uppsala site leadership team. Develop and maintain program plans with individual program managers/LPIs, including productivity programs. Participate in scheduled program reviews. Maintain and communicate appropriate Quality and program metrics. Utilize appropriate communication methods and processes at all levels of the organization to promote team goals, progress, and results. Adhere to the GEHC Quality System, using the PRD process and the EQPM during the engineering design process. Facilitate the protection of IP. Provide product quality support. Support Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) activities, as required. Quality Specific Goals: Be aware of and comply with the GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position. Complete all planned Quality & Compliance training within the defined deadlines. Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective action as required. Drive compliance/closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements before approving Design Outputs/Program Deliverables. Champion continuous improvement activities by initiating process and product quality improvement initiatives. Required Qualifications: Overall industry experience of more than 15 years with 10 years of engineering and/or program management and leadership experience. BS in Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or equivalent (defined as a High School Diploma/GED and 20 years relative experience). 15 years progressive experience as an engineer or scientist within the appropriate field of study, including 7 years experience in leadership within a manufacturing, development, or research environment. Experience in complex systems design, qualification, and support. Extensive experience and functional expertise in quality, reliability, and Lean. Strong experience in Stakeholder and Priority management, working closely with Business segment leaders and global teams. Demonstrated leadership and project management skills. Strong quantitative and analytical skills. Excellent interpersonal, facilitation, and coaching skills. Strong written and oral communication skills. High level of energy, drive, and enthusiasm. Strong process skills and business analysis skills. Strong English skills. Must be legally authorized to work in Sweden full-time. Must be willing to work in our Uppsala facility full-time. Desired Characteristics: MS or PhD in Engineering or Physics or equivalent experience. Advanced degree in relevant engineering disciplines, such as electronics or high energy physics. Experience in relevant complex electronics design, including RadioFrequency (RF) electronic systems. Familiar with artificial intelligence and deep learning technologies to either enhance engineering team efficiency or drive product performance. About the team: Every CT image a radiologist interprets passes through our software. We transform raw detector measurements into clinically meaningful images that help physicians diagnose strokes, detect tumors, identify fractures, and guide critical patient care decisions. This work requires balancing image quality, computational performance, radiation dose, and the realities of clinical workflows. Our team operates at the intersection of software engineering, applied mathematics, high-performance computing, and medical device development. Almost no engineer arrives with expertise in all these areas, and that is expected. The engineers who thrive here are deeply curious, learn rapidly, embrace challenging and ambiguous problems and are willing to step outside their comfort zone to develop new skills. Success in this role comes not from knowing everything on day one, but from having the curiosity, resilience, and drive to learn, contribute, and grow into increasingly complex technical challenges. In this role you will: Take reconstruction algorithms from research prototype to production running inside the scanner leveraging latest high-performance computing hardware (GPGPU/multicore CPU) Minimize software errors by applying right software engineering principles and design thinking Chase image quality and performance problems that cross algorithm, hardware, and system boundaries. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve the CT products and how we work Build expertise, take ownership of complex problems, show accountability while understanding business success is achieved as a team. Self-motivated and energized by solving difficult, ambiguous problems with limited direction. Takes ownership of problems, drives solutions to completion, and continuously seeks better approaches. Resourceful in overcoming obstacles and finding practical solutions when the path forward is unclear. Comfortable contributing across all phases of software development, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, debugging, performance optimization, and support. Strong systems-thinking skills with the ability to understand complex interactions across software and hardware components. Actively seeks feedback, learns from mistakes, and continuously improves technical and professional capabilities. Collaborative team player who elevates those around them through knowledge sharing, constructive discussion, and technical leadership. Demonstrates sound technical judgment, balancing innovation, quality, and delivery. Additional Technical Experience (Preferred) Experience with GPU programming technologies such as CUDA or OpenCL. High-performance computing, parallel processing, or performance optimization. AI/ML acceleration technologies, tensor cores, or deep learning workloads. IPC, microservices, containers, distributed systems, and REST APIs. GPU profiling and performance analysis tools. Medical imaging, scientific computing, or other computationally intensive software domains. Build sufficient domain knowledge to participate in technical design discussions and influence implementation decisions. Contribute code that is maintainable, well-tested, and meets medical device quality standards.
